I don't consent to the content on this site being used to train AI models.

-   This site's [robots.txt](robots.txt) asks known AI crawlers not to visit, including those run by OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta, Apple, Perplexity and Common Crawl.
-   Every page carries `noai` and `tdm-reservation` tags, which mark the content as reserved from text and data mining.
-   Content is licensed under [CC BY-NC 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/), which does not allow commercial reuse.
